en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-96 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ayoob ibn Nooh, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Qutaybat al-A’eshi that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said,
“It suffices for a believer to see God’s aid in the form of his enemies engaged in the Almighty God’s disobedience.”
